name: WC Crafters Rules for LearnDash
author: woocrafters

sections.description:
WC Crafters Rules for LearnDash helps administrators automate learner workflows with events, conditions, scopes, ordered actions, and priorities.

  • Free events: course, lesson, topic and quiz completion; course access changes.
  • Pro events: user registration, sign-in, group additions/removals, scheduled evaluations and developer events.
  • Conditions: roles, users, groups, course access/completion/progress, quiz scores/pass status, metadata, site dates, and access removal.
  • Free actions: enroll in a course, remove course enrollment, and email the learner.
  • Separate Pro add-on: add/remove groups, change safe learner roles, send HTTPS webhooks, run registered developer actions, and notify administrators/group leaders.
  • AJAX rule search, status filtering, pagination, editing, saves, and status changes.
  • Searchable multiple selections for users, courses, groups, lessons, topics and quiz audiences, with All options and title-based action target selection.
  • Execution logs, configurable retention, and optional data removal on uninstall.
  • Pro dry-run mode simulates available actions without side effects.
  • Responsive WooCrafters interface, WordPress icons, accessible form labels and local assets.
  • Extensible catalogs, lifecycle actions, and a reusable EDD license client for WooCrafters products.

All bundled features remain free without a license. Paid action implementations are supplied exclusively by the separately distributed Rules for LearnDash Pro add-on; no paid execution code is included in this package. Its disabled previews explain the upgrade without enabling paid actions. Keep the free base active alongside Pro. A valid WooCrafters license is required to execute Pro actions.

LearnDash LMS is required and is a separate commercial product available at https://www.learndash.com/. This plugin is an independent WooCrafters integration, not an official LearnDash product. WordPress cannot install LearnDash from its public plugin directory.

External services

The free rules engine makes no automatic license requests without a saved key.

Optional WooCrafters license service: activating a key sends the license key, site URL, product identifier/name, and WordPress environment to https://woocrafters.com/ using HTTPS. Checks run twice daily while a key is saved. Deactivation sends the same information to release the activation. License status, expiry, limited entitlement metadata, and the key are stored in a non-autoloaded WordPress option. The key is not rendered into the admin page. Service provider: WooCrafters (https://woocrafters.com/). Terms: https://woocrafters.com/terms-conditions/ . Privacy policy: https://woocrafters.com/privacy-policy/ . The service also receives normal HTTP connection information, such as the requesting IP address and WordPress HTTP user agent. Activation is optional and is initiated by an administrator; no license is needed for free automations.

Pro add-on webhook actions (not included in this package): only after an administrator creates and activates a webhook rule, a matching event sends the learner ID, event name, and limited course/quiz/group/lesson/topic context to the public HTTPS URL selected by that administrator. Redirects and private/local network URLs are rejected. Administrators are responsible for choosing an authorized endpoint and informing learners. No third-party webhook service is bundled.

Email actions use WordPress wp_mail and the site’s configured mail transport. They send the configured subject and message to the matching learner. Logs can contain learner IDs and action results. Logs are removed automatically after the configured retention period (default 30 days).

Support

For setup documentation, see https://woocrafters.com/docs/ . For product support, visit https://woocrafters.com/contact/ or email support@woocrafters.com. Include the plugin, WordPress, PHP and LearnDash versions and a description of the problem. Do not send license keys, passwords or learner records in public support requests.
sections.installation:
For an existing rules-for-learndash installation, deactivate the old free plugin before activating the renamed wc-crafters-rules-for-learndash package. Do not delete the old plugin with Remove data on uninstall enabled. Both names use the same existing rules and settings. Use the Pro companion package with its updated dependency header when switching to the renamed directory.

  1. Install and activate LearnDash LMS.
  2. Upload the wc-crafters-rules-for-learndash directory and activate WC Crafters Rules for LearnDash.
  3. Open WC Crafters Rules for LearnDash → Rules → Create rule.
  4. Configure a draft and review its event, audience and actions. Test with a controlled learner on a staging site.
  5. With licensed Pro, optionally enable Dry-run before testing. Turn it off before activating live actions. Inspect Activity after a matching event.
sections.faq:
Can I target one quiz, lesson, or course?

Yes. Choose the matching completion event, then select the item by title under Quizzes, Lessons, or Courses. Select multiple items to match any one of those items. Leave All selected for no restriction. Every restricted category must match; missing item context does not match. Action targets are selected individually by title; add ordered action rows to affect several courses or groups.

Is a license required?

No license is needed for this free package. Install and activate the separate Pro add-on AND activate a valid license to execute its paid actions. A LearnDash license is separate from a WooCrafters Pro license.

Can I execute arbitrary PHP or WordPress hooks?

No. Pro developers can register named actions; developers can extend events through documented filters. This prevents administrators from accidentally dispatching unrelated security-sensitive hooks.

Do scheduled rules run only once?

Scheduled rules require licensed Pro and repeat for matching users. Up to 200 users are evaluated per batch, approximately every 15 minutes depending on WordPress cron traffic. Use conditions to prevent repeated actions. Course/quiz scopes require an event carrying that context and therefore do not match scheduled evaluations.

What happens when LearnDash is unavailable?

The engine stops processing and displays an administrator dependency notice. Rules and settings remain stored.

What happens on deletion?

Rules, logs, and settings are retained by default. Enable Remove data on uninstall to delete the current site’s plugin tables and options when deleting the plugin. Deactivation alone keeps data.

Does this support network activation?

Use per-site activation. Network-wide activation is intentionally rejected; each site’s rules and settings are independent.
sections.changelog:
1.5.6

  • Added the distinctive WC Crafters display name and wc-crafters-rules-for-learndash translation domain.
  • Limited notices to plugin screens and removed repeated upgrade navigation.
  • Hardened administrator request methods, nonce field validation, and read-only editor input.
  • Preserved existing rules, options, cron hooks and Pro extension APIs.

1.5.4

  • Added distinct activation, refresh and deactivation confirmations.
  • Improved license metadata cards and localized expiry date, time and timezone.

1.5.3

  • Simplified administrator license entry with key format validation and specific EDD rejection messages.
  • Hidden upgrade prompts for active licenses and kept Pro activation notices visible until activation.
  • Synchronized activation, refresh and deactivation controls with current server status.

1.5.2

  • Added administrator-only saved license key display with Show/Hide controls.
  • Kept the key masked by default and retained it after status refresh.
  • Updated expiry, remaining activations and last-check time after license actions.

1.5.1

  • Aligned the WordPress minimum with LearnDash 5.2 and linked Upgrade to the planned Pro product permalink.
  • Added verified WooCrafters service terms, privacy and support links and clarified optional licensing data transfers.

1.5.0

  • Added name-based user multi-selection.
  • Moved group, role, webhook and developer action execution exclusively into the Pro add-on.
  • Added runtime rejection of unavailable actions, including dry-run.

1.3.0

  • Added searchable multi-select audience pickers and All controls for courses, groups, lessons, topics and quizzes.
  • Added exact lesson/topic/quiz event scoping with server-side target validation.
  • Replaced action/condition target ID entry with title selection.
  • Added an orange Upgrade submenu, disabled Pro action previews and Pro feature information.

1.2.1

  • Added WordPress object caching for rules, searches, counts and execution logs, with cache invalidation after data changes.
  • Resolved coding-standard and Plugin Check warnings through cache fixes and documented line-specific exceptions for custom-table operations and false positives.
  • Added a free-to-Pro installation and licensing guide.

1.2.0

  • Preserved the revised WooCrafters interface and added an Upgrade link.
  • Separated premium notification actions into an external Pro add-on.
  • Added request-local rule caching, stricter row validation, and simpler authorization.
  • Scoped license reminders to Pro installations and restored persistent dismissal.
  • Kept runtime LearnDash dependency checks without an unsupported directory dependency header.

1.1.0

  • Renamed to WC Crafters Rules for LearnDash by WooCrafters; existing wcrf data and developer namespaces retained.
  • Added responsive Bootstrap layout, unified tabs, AJAX tables/forms, support documentation, and permanent per-user notice dismissal.
  • Added shared catalogs, server validation, additional triggers, registered custom actions, and lifecycle hooks.
  • Hardened database error reporting, scope matching, role actions, HTTPS requests, license responses, expiry, and site binding.
  • Made all bundled features free without license gating.
